caption: Adding this one to my toddler meal-prep rotation 🤍 Whipped bone marrow is creamy, nutrient-dense, and perfect for making ahead and freezing in little portions. 🥄✨ How I made it: 🤍 Roast frozen bone marrow bones at 425°F for about 30 minutes, or until cooked all the way through. 🤍 Scoop the marrow into a bowl and chill in the fridge for about 20 minutes. 🤍 Transfer to the @hauswirt_baking M5 Max Stand Mixer. 🤍 Whisk for a little over 3 minutes, until light, creamy & fluffy ✨ 🤍 Store some in a glass jar for the week and freeze the rest in a silicone mold to grab as needed. Why bone marrow? It’s naturally rich in fat and provides nutrients like vitamin B12 and iron. Plus, that soft, whipped texture makes it easy to mix into my toddler’s meals. 🤍 The Hauswirt M5 Max Stand Mixer made getting that silky whipped texture so simple!
